transformations.description: Combines current R10 Ida and Vuelta lists into one complete event cycle after removing the duplicated handoff 1311 and repeated cycle-boundary 091. The base pattern removes diagram-marked event-only stops 1216 and 1221; the event pattern retains them. Both close from 236 to 091 exactly once.
Combines the current ordered R11 Carrús Ida and Vuelta lists after removing duplicated handoff 1220 and repeated cycle-boundary 015. The pattern closes from 008 to 015 exactly once.

Builds the distinct schedule-dependent Sector V cycle from the uploaded diagram: common directed corridor 088 through airport and back to 323, followed by the explicitly listed Sector V branch 033, 034, 128, 130, 305, 312, 306, then closes to 088. It is not concatenated with the Carrús branch.
Uses municipal stop code as stable identity. Accepted objects are copied complete-object exact. New codes receive deterministic elche-stop-/elche-place- identities and singleton StopPlaces.
Serializes StopPlaces and StopNodes in ascending numeric municipal-code order and creates deterministic lexicographically ordered ZIP entries with fixed metadata.
Writes final scenario assets, computes asset SHA-256 values and aggregate contentHash, and appends exactly one catalog descriptor.

warnings: Runtime StopNode sourceReferences remain empty for new nodes because that field accepts only genuine OpenStreetMap platform or stop_position evidence. Municipal codes, route pages, diagrams and map coordinates remain provenance evidence.

R10 stop codes 1216 and 1221 are marked by the supplied R10 diagram as event-dependent. The current ordered page lists them in its normal direction lists, so both base and event patterns are retained rather than silently choosing one.

R11 source material disagrees at the urban branch. The current ordered page exposes the Carrús cycle. The supplied diagram explicitly lists separate Carrús and Sector V branches and shows code 323 in the common upper boundary. No current ordered textual Sector V list was found.

The R11 Sector V pattern is therefore diagram-derived and lower-confidence than the current Carrús pattern. It preserves only labels and order visibly supported by the diagram and does not invent a synthetic connector between the two branches.

The current R11 Carrús page includes IFA stops 1216 and 1221; the supplied R11 diagram does not. The current ordered source is retained for the Carrús pattern, while the diagram-derived Sector V pattern follows the diagram and omits them.
Different municipal codes remain distinct StopNodes and singleton StopPlaces even when names or coordinates are close. No name-, proximity- or exact-coordinate merge was performed.
closesLoop creates exactly one final-to-first edge per pattern. Internal loops remain possible only when produced by explicit consecutive entries or non-consecutive revisits.
Physical StopPlace creation does not create route edges, reverse patterns, cross-pattern itinerary edges or vehicle lifecycle edges.
All earlier scenario files, including the grandfathered Torrevieja sourceReferences issue, are preserved byte-for-byte and are not corrected in this build.
